summary.title: University Student Information System- STRIDE Threat Model
summary.description:
The University Student Information System is designed to handle sensitive student data and academic processes. It includes:

* Student Registration Portal - used by students and faculty to register the courses.
* Grade Management System - used by faculty/admin to manage and update student grades.
* Academic Records Database - stores student profiles, registration history, and grades.
* Email Notification Service - sends course and grade updates to students and faculty.
